assertions.assertion: Uses AddAspNetIdentityMigration() with a connection string pointing to the existing ASP.NET Identity database
assertions.rationale: `options.AddAspNetIdentityMigration(migration => { migration.ConnectionString = ... legacy Identity DB ... })` is shown pointing at the existing database.

assertions.assertion: States that existing password hashes are preserved (users can log in with current passwords)
assertions.rationale: A dedicated section explains password hashes are imported verbatim so users log in immediately with the same password, no reset.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that migration is idempotent (subsequent runs skip already-imported users)
assertions.rationale: It states the migration is idempotent and that subsequent runs skip users already imported.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that after migration users can enroll in passwordless methods
assertions.rationale: It notes imported users can enroll in OTP, TOTP, and passkeys after migration while retaining their password fallback.
